label: Tickets (historical)
purpose: Historical sales, cost, profit, bookings and passengers of non-hotel services sold by Dubai Link Direct — mostly UAE tourist visas, plus tours, attraction tickets, chauffeur and meet & greet — 2015 to 2021. Data stops in 2022: never use it for recent periods.
grain: One service booking line (a service option booked for a customer).
use_for: ancillary (visa, tour, ticket) sales, cost and profit in 2015–2021
visa service volumes and revenue before 2022
historical service sales by service, customer, market or supplier
not_for: any period after 2021 (use Bookings, product types Ticket, Transfer and Generic Booking)

coverage.note: Historical cube: data stops in 2022 (last booking June 2022). Steady monthly data mid-2015 to 2019 (busiest year by bookings 2019); 2020 has no data April–July and a sales spike September–November; 2021 has only a few bookings a month; 2022 a single booking. Never use it for 2022 or later.

rules: Historical cube: data only from 2015-02 to 2022-06 and almost nothing after 2020. Never answer questions about 2022 or later from it; for recent ticket, transfer or visa sales use the Bookings cube.
Use the cube's measures only; never SUM a column.
List every breakdown column together with its needs_columns (group-with helper columns).
[% Profit] is profit ÷ cost (markup), not profit ÷ sales; never add it across rows.
Filter visas by 'Service Name'[Service Name]; 'Service Type' puts most tourist visas under "Service".
'Booking Date'[Month] and 'Arrival Date'[Month] are month numbers without the year; group with [Year] for monthly trends.
Never use the LY measures; compare periods by querying each period.
